items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: And then we got a boy from California by the name of Biehl.

ctx.x: Did he go out on the road with you, or did he just make the record session, because the next record session, which was done a few months later, I think in April, I think another piano player was playing.

Yes. He went out on the road with us. And he stayed out on the road with us -- I've forgotten just how long. It may -- you might have some data on that, just how long he stayed. And then we got a boy from California by the name of Biehl.
